quests.title: Sandman - Desert Sticker (Key Quest 1)
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - Key Quests & 7 Desert Stickers
steps: Speak to Sandman in Beach Town - Paradise.
Complete all 5 cycles of any 5 of the 7 Desert Sticker quests below to obtain 5x Desert Sticker.
Turn in 5x Desert Sticker to Sandman.

source.from: Complete Cycle 5 of any 5 Desert Sticker quests below

quests.notes: Recommended 5 Stickers: Homeless Ian -> Bunny Maid -> Al-Hauri (they chain together!) + Miranda Watty + Vagabond Eloy (or Skipper Min).

quests.title: Homeless Ian - This Generation's Last Romantic [Desert Sticker #1]
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - Key Quests & 7 Desert Stickers
steps: Speak to Homeless Ian in Beach Town - Paradise.
Hunt Sea Scorpion (Lv.22) or Hula Octopus (Lv.27) in Desert Beach Field 3 / 4 for 2x Flower Necklace per cycle (10x total for 5 cycles).
Save all 5x Water Bucket rewards for Bunny Maid's sticker quest!

items: Per Cycle: 1x Water Bucket | Cycle 4: 1x Homeless Ian Card | Cycle 5: 1x Desert Sticker

quests.title: Bunny Maid - Well Watching Bunny Maid [Desert Sticker #2]
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - Key Quests & 7 Desert Stickers
quests.prereqText: Level 25+ (Uses Water Buckets from Homeless Ian)
steps: Speak to Bunny Maid by the well in Beach Town - Paradise.
Hunt Hula Octopus (Lv.27) or Grumpy Octopus (Lv.29) in Desert Beach Field 3 / 4 for 2x Octopus Leg per cycle (10x total).
Turn in 1x Water Bucket (from Homeless Ian) + 2x Octopus Leg per cycle for 5 cycles. Save the 5x Filled Water Bucket rewards for Al-Hauri!

source.from: Reward from Homeless Ian - This Generation's Last Romantic

items: Per Cycle: 1x Filled Water Bucket | Cycle 4: 1x Bunny Maid Card | Cycle 5: 1x Desert Sticker

quests.title: Al-Hauri - Help Al-Hauri [Desert Sticker #3]
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - Key Quests & 7 Desert Stickers
quests.prereqText: Level 25+ (Uses Filled Water Buckets from Bunny Maid)
steps: Enter Paradise Spa in Beach Town - Paradise and speak to Al-Hauri.
Hand over 1x Filled Water Bucket (from Bunny Maid's quest) per cycle for 5 cycles.

source.from: Reward from Bunny Maid - Well Watching Bunny Maid

items: Cycles 1-3: Pink/Blue Potion B | Cycle 4: 1x Al-Hauri Card | Cycle 5: 1x Desert Sticker

quests.title: Miranda Watty - Miranda Watty's Hobbies [Desert Sticker #4]
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - Key Quests & 7 Desert Stickers
steps: Speak to Miranda Watty in Beach Town - Paradise.
Hunt Pineapple (Lv.24) in Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis for 2x Pineapple Mask per cycle (10x total for 5 cycles).

source.map: Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis

items: Per Cycle: 1x 500 Galder Coupon | Cycle 4: 1x Miranda Watty Card | Cycle 5: 1x Desert Sticker

quests.title: Vagabond Eloy - Eloy's Sensitive Skin (1) [Desert Sticker #5]
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - Key Quests & 7 Desert Stickers
steps: Speak to Vagabond Eloy in Beach Town - Paradise.
Drill in Desert Beach Field 2 - Sand Palace (10m, Sand) for 2x Sun Cream per cycle (10x total for 5 cycles).

items: Per Cycle: 3x Pink/Blue Potion C | Cycle 4: 1x Vagabond Eloy Card | Cycle 5: 1x Desert Sticker

quests.title: Skipper Min - Dude Needs a Bath! [Desert Sticker #6]
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - Key Quests & 7 Desert Stickers
steps: Speak to Skipper Min in Beach Town - Paradise.
Drill in Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis (10m, Sand) for 1x Soap, 1x Shampoo, and 1x Bath Sponge per cycle (5x each total for 5 cycles).

source.map: Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis
Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis
Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis

items: Cycles 1-4: 1x 500 Galder Coupon | Cycle 4: 1x Skipper Card | Cycle 5: 1x Survival Stick + 1x Desert Sticker

quests.title: Eliza Bath - Eliza Bath's Curiosity [Desert Sticker #7]
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - Key Quests & 7 Desert Stickers
steps: Speak to Eliza Bath inside Paradise Spa.
Drill in Desert Beach Field 3 & Field 4 (10m, Sand) for 1x Lucky Letter, 1x Cursed Letter, 1x Love Letter, 1x Confession Letter, and 1x Farewell Letter per cycle (5x each total).

items: Cycles 1-4: 1x 500 Galder Coupon | Cycle 4: 1x Eliza Bath Card | Cycle 5: 1x Octopus Hat Neo + 1x Desert Sticker

quests.title: Sandman - Legendary Recipe (Key Quest 2)
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - Key Quests & 7 Desert Stickers
steps: Speak to Sandman in Beach Town - Paradise after turning in 5 Desert Stickers.
Hunt Sand Demon (Lv.28) in Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis for 5x Sand Cake and 1x Sand Glass.
Drill in Desert Beach Fields 1-4 (10m, Sand) for 2x Limestone, 1x Garden Trowel, and 1x Oasis Water.
Return all items to Sandman.

source.map: Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis
Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis

quests.title: Sandman - The Miracle of Sand (Key Quest 3)
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - Key Quests & 7 Desert Stickers
steps: Speak to Sandman in Beach Town - Paradise.
Hunt Sand Demon (Lv.28) in Desert Beach Field 3 for 1x Legendary Recipe.
Enter Pyramid Dungeon (via Field 3) and drill in Pyramid Dungeon 1-6 (20~30m, Rock) for 1x Glyph Tablet.
Return both items to Sandman to receive the Adventurer's Book and Weapon Ticket A!

source.map: Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis

quests.notes: Keep your Adventurer's Book safe! You will need it later for the Caballa Relics Key Quest chain.

quests.title: Sandman - Go to Megalopolis Square (Key Transition)
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - Key Quests & 7 Desert Stickers
steps: Speak to Sandman in Beach Town - Paradise.
Travel to Megalopolis Square, enter the Megalopolis Guild Office, and speak to Guild Clerk Esther.

quests.title: Don Giuvanni - Calming Down Don Giuvanni
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
steps: Speak to Don Giuvanni in Desert Beach Field 2 - Sand Palace.
Drill in Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis (10m, Sand) for 1x Soap per cycle (3x total for 3 cycles).

source.map: Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis

items: Cycle 3: 1x Don Giuvanni Card (Unlocks Star Gazer Stella)

quests.title: Star Gazer Stella - The Star Gazer
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
quests.prereqText: Don Giuvanni - Calming Down Don Giuvanni (3 Cycles)
steps: After completing all 3 cycles of Calming Down Don Giuvanni, speak to Star Gazer Stella in Desert Beach Field 2 - Sand Palace to unlock the Star Gazing fortune system.

quests.title: Monkey T - Monkey T's Loyalty - 2
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
steps: Speak to Monkey T in Desert Beach Field 1 - Delta Island.
Hunt Shell Trap (Lv.19) in Desert Beach Field 1 for 5x Iron Grass per cycle.

quests.title: Driller Marky - Crazy Drilling! (With Explorer Reina & Indiana John Sub-Quests)
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
steps: Speak to Driller Marky in Beach Town - Paradise to start 'Crazy Drilling!'.

Sub-Quest 1 (Indiana John - Acquire Rare Artifacts, in Paradise): Hunt Sand Demon (Lv.28, Field 3) for 1x Broken Artifact 1, Fan Lizard (Lv.26, Field 4) for 1x Broken Artifact 2, and Cannon Shell (Lv.33, Field 4) for 1x Broken Artifact 3. Turn them in to Indiana John for 1x Earth Charm (+49,389 Base EXP).
Sub-Quest 2 (Explorer Reina - Driller Master Test, in Paradise): Collect Driller King Necklace, Driller King Ring, and Driller King Bag to receive 1x Drilling Certification (+49,389 Base EXP).
Return 1x Earth Charm and 1x Drilling Certification to Driller Marky to learn the Crazy Drilling skill!

source.map: Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis

source.from: Reward from Indiana John - Acquire Rare Artifacts
Reward from Explorer Reina - Driller Master Test

quests.title: Blacksmith Marx - Collection!
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
steps: Speak to Blacksmith Marx in Desert Beach Mine - Crystal Copper.
Drill 3x Pure Tin in 1st Mining Lot of Crystal Copper (10~20m, Rock) and 3x Flawless Amethyst in 2nd Mining Lot of Crystal Copper per cycle (15x each total for 5 cycles).

items: Cycles 1-4: Tornado Stone / 500 Galder Coupons / Pink Potion C | Cycle 5: 2x Pure Sulfur + 2x Flawless Agate

quests.title: Pharaoh Boy - Young Pharaoh's Request
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
quests.location: Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis
steps: Speak to Pharaoh Boy in Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis.
Drill inside Pyramid Dungeon 1-6 (20~30m, Rock) for 1x Uraeus Statue, 1x Nekhbet Statue, and 1x Round Bone Seal per cycle (5x each total).

items: Per Cycle: 500 Galder Coupon | Cycle 4: 1x Pharaoh Boy Card

quests.title: Card Girl - Desert Beach Card Girl Quests (1 to 5)
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
steps: Quest 1 (Lv.10+): Turn in 1x Sea Scorpion Card (from Sea Scorpion Lv.22, Field 3) -> 8,577 TM EXP + 2x Arcana Smart Card.
Quest 2 (Lv.15+): Turn in 1x Sand Demon Card (from Sand Demon Lv.28, Field 3) -> 19,920 TM EXP + 2x Arcana Smart Card.
Quest 3 (Lv.25+): Turn in 1x Nephthys Card & 1x Isis Card (from Nephthys Lv.38 & Isis Lv.42, Pyramid Dungeon 2) -> 79,191 TM EXP + 3x Arcana Smart Card.
Quest 4 (Lv.25+): Turn in 1x Shell Trap Card (from Shell Trap Lv.19, Field 1) -> 79,191 TM EXP + 4x Arcana Smart Card.
Quest 5 (Lv.25+): Turn in 1x Fan Lizard Card (from Fan Lizard Lv.26, Field 4) -> 79,191 TM EXP + 5x Arcana Smart Card.

source.map: Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis
Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis

quests.notes: Save at least 1x Arcana Smart Card for the Level 65 Arbiter of Wisdom Enlightenment quest!

quests.title: Hunter Yuri - Desert Beach Hunter Girl & Paradise Hunter Girl
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
quests.location: Gate of Desert Beach & Desert Beach Field 3
steps: Gate of Desert Beach (Lv.10+): Speak to Hunter Yuri and hunt 15x Fanta Slime (Lv.18) in 15 min on Field 1 -> 2,308 Base / 721 TM EXP + Hunter Girl's Thank You Gift.
Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis (Lv.20+): Speak to Hunter Yuri and hunt 15x Sand Demon (Lv.28) in 15 min on Field 3 -> 12,647 Base / 3,584 TM EXP + Hunter Girl's Happy Gift.

objectives.map: Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis

quests.title: Hunter Yuri & Assistant Hunter - Paradise Monster Guild Quests
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
steps: Lv.15-20: Hunt 5x Golden Mole (Lv.20) in 10 min on Field 1 -> 3,935 Base / 1,080 TM EXP.
Lv.21-25: Hunt 10x Pineapple (Lv.24) in 15 min on Field 3 -> 9,077 Base / 2,644 TM EXP.
Lv.26-33: Hunt 15x Cannon Shell (Lv.33) in 20 min on Field 4 -> 15,628 Base / 4,869 TM EXP.
Lv.34-40: Hunt 20x Gold G (Lv.36) in 25 min in Pyramid Dungeon 3/5 -> 30,305 Base / 12,428 TM EXP.
Lv.41+: Hunt 30x Rotten Mummy (Lv.43) in 30 min in Pyramid Dungeon 4/5/6 -> 49,340 Base / 22,561 TM EXP.

quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
quests.location: Pyramid Dungeon 1 - Hall of the Slave
steps: Lv.25-30: Hunt 20x Oran G (Lv.30) in 20 min in Pyramid Dungeon 1 -> 14,878 TM EXP + 2x 500 Galder Coupon.
Lv.31-35: Hunt 20x Uraeus (Lv.34) in 20 min in Pyramid Dungeon 2 -> 27,860 TM EXP + 2x 500 Galder Coupon.
Lv.36-45: Hunt 20x Seth (Lv.45) in 20 min in Pyramid Dungeon 4/5 -> 51,796 TM EXP + 2x 500 Galder Coupon.
Lv.46+: Hunt 20x Queen Mummy (Lv.49) in 20 min in Pyramid Dungeon 6 -> 104,179 TM EXP + 3x 500 Galder Coupon.

quests.title: Monkey T - Daily Quest - Desert Beach & Keeper Julio - Storage Mission 1
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
quests.location: Beach Town - Paradise & Gate of Desert Beach
steps: Monkey T (Paradise): Hunt Punisher Cannon Shell (Lv.38) or Cannon Shell (Lv.33) in Field 4 for 1x Sleeping Socks -> 16,421 TM EXP + 1x Daily Coupon.
Keeper Julio (Gate of Desert Beach): Turn in 10x to 100x Crystal (drilled in Coral Beach / Desert Beach Fields, 10m Sand) -> up to 179,136 TM EXP + 7x 500 Galder Coupon + 1x Chaos's Feather 20.

quests.title: Pharaoh Boy & Gods - Young Pharaoh's Awakening (Pyramid Unique Gear Chain)
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
steps: Step 1 (Anubis - Mission 1 & 2, Pyramid Dungeon 2 -> Room of Truth): Hunt 30x Soul Taker (1) in 10 min for Anubis Card, then 20x Soul Taker (2) in 10 min for 1x Piece of Free Soul 1.
Step 2 (Nefertiti - Nefertiti's Mission, Pyramid Dungeon 6): Drill in Pyramid Dungeon 1-6 (Depth 20~30m, Rock) for 15x Book of the Dead -> 1x Piece of Free Soul 2 + Nefertiti Card.

Step 3 (Bastet - Bastet's Mission, Pyramid Dungeon 3): Hunt Nephthys (Lv.38) and Isis (Lv.42) in Pyramid Dungeon 2 for Blue Feather, Nephthys' Song, Red Feather, and Isis' Song -> 1x Piece of Free Soul 3.
Step 4 (Pharaoh Boy - Young Pharaoh's Awakening, Desert Beach Field 3): Turn in Piece of Free Soul 1, 2, and 3 to Pharaoh Boy for a Pyramid Unique Equipment piece!

items: Random Pyramid Unique Gear: Pharaoh Hat / Golden Sword / Golden Lion Shield / Ankh Pendant

quests.title: Nefertiti - Canopic Jar & Tutankhamen Boss Access Trials
quests.chapter: Desert Beach - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Pyramid Dungeon
quests.location: Pyramid Dungeon 6 - Hall of the Queen
steps: Canopic Jar (Nefertiti, 5 Cycles): Collect 3x Harpy, 3x Imsety, 3x Duamutef, and 3x Qebehsenuef from Mummy monsters in Pyramid Dungeon 3-6.
Boss Entry (Bastet): Hunt Seth (Lv.45) in Pyramid Dungeon 4 & 5 for 1x Subject's Mask and 1x Subject's Earrings to enter Room of Guardian.

Complete Lieutenant (Test of Calmness -> Gray Round Seal), Sergeant (Test of Quickness -> Dark Round Seal), and Captain (Test of Knowledge -> Red Round Seal) to enter Pyramid Dungeon 7 - Doom of Pharaoh (Boss Tutankhamen)!
